name: Pad Thai
source:
A short kinetic visual novel for the toxic yuri vn jam 2 with around 4.3k words (~40 minutes). Follow B in her everyday life and how she lives in modern-day America with mental illness and trauma.
(taken from itch.io page)
translation:
一部为“Toxic Yuri VN Jam 2”创作的短篇单线视觉小说，全篇约4300词（流程约40分钟）。跟随B走入她的日常生活，看身负精神疾病与心理创伤的她如何在当代美国社会中挣扎生活。
[摘自itch.io页面]
